vscode-server.label: VS Code Server
vscode-server.description: Browser-based VS Code editor (code-server) accessible at http://localhost:4040

streetsidesoftware.code-spell-checker.label: Code Spell Checker
streetsidesoftware.code-spell-checker.description: Catches spelling errors in code, comments, and strings. Supports camelCase splitting and multiple languages.

gruntfuggly.todo-tree.label: Todo Tree
gruntfuggly.todo-tree.description: Finds TODO, FIXME, HACK, and other annotations across the project and displays them in a tree view.

usernamehw.errorlens.label: Error Lens
usernamehw.errorlens.description: Shows errors and warnings inline next to the code, making problems immediately visible without hovering.

editorconfig.editorconfig.label: EditorConfig
editorconfig.editorconfig.description: Applies .editorconfig settings (indent style, charset, trim whitespace) automatically.

esbenp.prettier-vscode.label: Prettier
esbenp.prettier-vscode.description: Opinionated formatter for JSON, YAML, Markdown, HTML, CSS, and more. Language-specific formatters take precedence.

eamodio.gitlens.label: GitLens
eamodio.gitlens.description: Rich Git integration: inline blame, line/file history, commit search, and visual comparisons. Adds ~50MB to image.

python.label: Python
python.description: IntelliSense (Pylance), debugging, linting, Jupyter notebook support, and virtual environment management.

python.label: Ruff
python.description: Extremely fast Python linter and formatter (written in Rust). Replaces pylint, flake8, black, and isort in one tool.

python.label: Jupyter
python.description: Run and edit Jupyter notebooks directly in VS Code. Includes cell execution, variable explorer, and plot viewer.

node.label: ESLint
node.description: Integrates ESLint into VS Code for JavaScript and TypeScript linting with auto-fix on save.

go.label: Go
go.description: Official Go extension: IntelliSense via gopls, debugging via Delve, formatting, testing, and code navigation.

rust.label: rust-analyzer
rust.description: Fast and feature-rich Rust language server: completions, inline type hints, diagnostics, and refactoring.

java.label: Language Support for Java
java.description: Java IntelliSense, code navigation, refactoring, and Maven/Gradle project support via Eclipse JDT.

java.label: Debugger for Java
java.description: Lightweight Java debugger with breakpoints, step execution, variable inspection, and hot code replace.

cpp.label: C/C++
cpp.description: IntelliSense, debugging (GDB/LLDB), code formatting, and code navigation for C and C++.

dotnet.label: C# Dev Kit
dotnet.description: Full C# development experience: IntelliSense, refactoring, debugging, test explorer, and solution management.

php.label: Intelephense
php.description: High-performance PHP language server with completions, diagnostics, formatting, and go-to-definition.

ruby.label: Ruby LSP
ruby.description: Shopify's Ruby language server: code navigation, completions, diagnostics, formatting, and debugging.

dart.label: Dart
dart.description: Dart language support: IntelliSense, debugging, syntax highlighting, code formatting, and pub integration.

flutter.label: Dart
flutter.description: Dart language support: IntelliSense, debugging, syntax highlighting, code formatting, and pub integration.

flutter.label: Flutter
flutter.description: Flutter development tools: widget inspector, hot reload, device selector, and Flutter-specific code actions.

kotlin.label: Kotlin
kotlin.description: Kotlin language support: syntax highlighting, code snippets, and basic IntelliSense.
